Does a higher capital gains tax raise revenue?
Assume the rate doubles.

It depends on how much realising gains is deferred. Three effects matter:
and they pull in different directions.

Three effects

  • Timing. Owners choose when to sell.
  • Lock-in. Capital stays in the appreciated asset.
  • Realisation. Revenue can fall as the rate rises.

What decides the sign

The elasticity of realisations is what decides the sign. ⁠CBO

The base matters as much as the rate. ⁠NBER

A four-step check:

  1. Measure the tax base.
  2. Estimate the elasticity.
